major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open every cooldown window with Halo so its slow damage and its Manifested Power and Sustained Potency procs are already ramping when Voidform starts.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Four live ids share the name Halo; 120644 is the shadow cast id seen in 5/5 sampled parses (21 casts). 453094 is the buff aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Voidform
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press Voidform on cooldown once Shadow Word: Pain is on at least as many targets as Vampiric Touch, then prioritize Void Volley inside it so you do not lose a cast.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 228260 is the cast id (13 casts in 5/5 parses); 194249 is the Voidform self aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Power Infusion as soon as you are in Voidform, and with Twins of the Sun Priestess put the copy on an ally who bursts on the same cadence, never at the cost of your own uses.

major_cooldowns.name: Void Torrent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Voidweaver, cast Void Torrent whenever your dots are up and you are not holding Tentacle Slam, then spend Void Blast and Shadow Word: Madness inside the Entropic Rift it spawns.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses, which are all Archon builds; 263165 is the castable id per its tooltip, 289577 is the passive twin.

defensives.name: Dispersion
defensives.usage_rule: Press Dispersion to ride out a lethal hit or a heavy damage phase, and place it in a gap between your cooldowns since it stops your casting.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Press Desperate Prayer as soon as you drop below 75% health for the instant heal and the extra health pool.

defensives.name: Vampiric Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Turn on Vampiric Embrace just before heavy raid damage so your damage tops the group up.

defensives.name: Fade
defensives.usage_rule: Press Fade ahead of a known hit for its damage reduction and to shed threat after a burst window.

rules.description: Keep Shadow Word: Madness up on your target
rules.action: Spend on Shadow Word: Madness before it falls off, and again whenever you are about to cap Insanity.

rules.description: Keep Shadow Word: Pain up on your target
rules.action: Reapply Shadow Word: Pain as it falls off, and use it as one of your movement casts.

rules.description: Keep Vampiric Touch up on your target
rules.action: Refresh Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam, and hard cast it when no charge is coming back in time.

rules.description: Mind Flay: Insanity over Mind Flay when it procs
rules.action: Channel Mind Flay: Insanity while its proc is up instead of plain Mind Flay, and cut the channel short for anything higher in the priority.

rules.description: Spend Shadowy Insight on Mind Blast
rules.action: Press Mind Blast as soon as Shadowy Insight procs so the free cast is not lost.
Send Halo first so its damage and procs are already ramping when you enter Voidform.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Death takes over in execute range
rules.action: Replace your Mind Flay filler with Shadow Word: Death once the target is in execute range.

source_summary: Shadow builds every cooldown window around Voidform: get Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch rolling, send Halo first so its slow ramp is already generating, then enter Voidform and follow it with Power Infusion, prioritizing Void Volley inside the window. Between windows the rotation is Shadow Word: Madness uptime without capping Insanity, Mind Blast on cooldown, and reacting to Shadowy Insight and Mind Devourer procs, with Mind Flay as the interruptible filler and Shadow Word: Death in execute range. Voidweaver builds drop Halo for Void Torrent and spend Void Blast inside Entropic Rift.
